dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-contrast white perimeters forming distinct 'C' and partial 'O' configurations against a dark grey base; clear gradient transition from dark outer field to high-intensity white border and darker central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical high-intensity white pixel clusters, primarily situated along the superior dorsal ridge and as terminal nodes on linear texture extensions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Spatial arrangement forms an elongated, irregular polygonal network connecting the centroids of the primary dorsal 'C' structure, the secondary mid-lateral ring, and three prominent high-intensity blobs on the upper lateral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse, low-intensity light-grey patch located on the ventral-lateral neck region, exhibiting a softer texture boundary than the dorsal annuli.
